Title: Persona
Text: Kavya, postpaid customer on Unlimited, uses about 6 GB a month (synthetic). Ignores banners; calls 611 after bill shocks.

Title: Root cause
Text: Nobody shows customers the plan that fits their own usage: one upgrade banner for all, and a playbook that only moves people up.

Title: Evidence
Text: Synthetic: 31% would be $3+/month better off; 39% of Unlimited users use < 10 GB; 2.9% of changes went to Unlimited; playbook shocks the bill 62% of the time.

Title: Goal
Text: Find where recommendation and AI can match each customer to the right plan and add-ons, honestly, and test the revenue impact.

Title: O1 Bill under every option
Text: Calculate each customer's monthly bill and slowed data under every eligible plan and add-on. Why AI: Not AI, but the feature that makes the recommender honest. Evidence: 31% better off elsewhere Stage: S1, S3

Title: O2 Eligibility rules
Text: Catalogue rules: student, 55+, family size, prepaid moves. Why AI: Rules, not ML; must be exact. Evidence: plan terms Stage: S1

Title: O3 Recommender (hybrid ranker)
Text: Rank options by what similar customers chose, their usage and the bill impact. Why AI: Learns trade-offs a playbook can't. Evidence: playbook top-3 hit 67% Stage: S2, S4

Title: O4 Fit-first guardrail + show-nothing gate
Text: Drop bill-shock suggestions; show nothing unless the customer is $3+ better off. Why AI: Trust. Evidence: 62% bill shock today Stage: S2

Title: O5 AI-written in-app message
Text: LLM writes headline, reason and bill change; code checks numbers, names and wording. Why AI: Language task, grounded. Evidence: banners ignored Stage: S2

Title: O6 Pre-trip roaming nudge
Text: Suggest a pass when travel is detected or booked. Why AI: Timing model; needs trip signals. Evidence: 53 travellers with no pass Stage: S3

Title: O7 Agent screen with the same suggestions
Text: Agents see the top 3 and reasons during calls. Why AI: Reuse. Evidence: playbook upsell only; needs agent-desktop integration Stage: S4

Title: O8 A/B test: fit first vs balanced vs banner
Text: Measure adoption, revenue, complaints and churn. Why AI: Decides the revenue trade-off with evidence. Evidence: no measurement today Stage: S5

Title: O9 Automatic plan switching
Text: Move customers without asking. Why AI: Fast, but consent and trust risk. Evidence: regulatory Stage: S5

Title: O10 Revenue-maximising ranker
Text: Rank by NovaCell revenue. Why AI: Easy; recreates the banner problem. Evidence: banner ignored Stage: S2

Title: Scoring rubric
Text: Impact (1-5): customers affected + money at stake + trust. Feasibility (1-5): data available + technique maturity + cost of being wrong + effort. Do first = Impact >= 4 and Feasibility >= 4.

Title: Should do
Text: Recommend from each customer's own usage and the exact bill change.

Title: Should do
Text: Include suggestions that lower the bill.

Title: Should do
Text: Show nothing when the plan already fits.

Title: Should do
Text: Give a plain reason for every suggestion.

Title: Should do
Text: Measure revenue, complaints and churn against a control group.

Title: Should NOT do
Text: Change a plan or add anything without the customer's tap.

Title: Should NOT do
Text: Push suggestions that raise the bill with no usage reason.

Title: Should NOT do
Text: Use pressure or scarcity wording.

Title: Should NOT do
Text: Use gender or region, or tell customers they were tracked.

Title: Should NOT do
Text: Move postpaid customers to prepaid from the app.
